title: Delegation link v1
description: Closes the I-2 residual 'delegate then settle' (S1 finding F7). Written by the case keeper, never by a client, when agent_run.delegate is accepted for a Field Case episode: it ties the agent run's actor (delegate) to the principal that delegated it (delegator), the episode and the assignment. Settlement of an episode is refused with SELF_SETTLEMENT_REFUSED (the code case-record-append.v1 already uses for I-2) when the settling principal is an executor of the episode, or is the delegator of any executor of the episode, directly or through a chain of links. Stored as an append-only line in cases/<case_id>/delegation_links.jsonl (path is WP-21's; the record shape is this contract's).

principal.description: A SEA-Forge actor identity (S1-S2) or, from S3, the shared identity principal; compared by exact string equality.

delegator.description: The authenticated principal on whose authority the run was delegated (the request actor; on_behalf_of when a gateway sent it).

delegate.description: The actor identity the agent run executes as.

expires_at.description: After this time no new run may start under the link; settlement checks still use it (a link is never deleted).

Settlement.description: The input of the I-2 check, as WP-21 assembles it: the settling principal and every link of the episode.
